const getAllEventData = require('getAllEventData');
const getEventData = require('getEventData');
const getRequestHeader = require('getRequestHeader');
const getCookieValues = require('getCookieValues');
const setCookie = require('setCookie');
const sendHttpRequest = require('sendHttpRequest');
const sha256Sync = require('sha256Sync');
const getTimestampMillis = require('getTimestampMillis');
const generateRandom = require('generateRandom');
const computeEffectiveTldPlusOne = require('computeEffectiveTldPlusOne');
const parseUrl = require('parseUrl');
const encodeUriComponent = require('encodeUriComponent');
const decodeUriComponent = require('decodeUriComponent');
const JSON = require('JSON');
const getType = require('getType');
const makeString = require('makeString');
const makeInteger = require('makeInteger');
const makeNumber = require('makeNumber');
const Math = require('Math');
const Object = require('Object');
const logToConsole = require('logToConsole');

const TAG_NAME = 'Wascer OpenAI Ads Conversions';
const API_ENDPOINT = 'https://bzr.openai.com/v1/events';
const INTEGRATION_SOURCE = 'wascer';
const GTM_PREVIEW_ORIGIN = 'https://gtm-msr.appspot.com/';
const REQUEST_TIMEOUT = 10000;
const STORE_TIMEOUT = 5000;
const HEX_LOWER = '0123456789abcdef';
const HEX_ANY = '0123456789abcdefABCDEF';
const ZERO_DECIMAL = 'BIF,CLP,DJF,GNF,IDR,ISK,JPY,KMF,KRW,MGA,PYG,RWF,UGX,VND,VUV,XAF,XOF,XPF';
const THREE_DECIMAL = 'BHD,IQD,JOD,KWD,LYD,OMR,TND';
const CITY_MAX = 128;
const ZIP_MAX = 32;

const DATA_TYPE_BY_EVENT = {
  page_viewed: 'contents',
  contents_viewed: 'contents',
  items_added: 'contents',
  checkout_started: 'contents',
  order_created: 'contents',
  app_installed: 'customer_action',
  app_opened: 'customer_action',
  lead_created: 'customer_action',
  registration_completed: 'customer_action',
  appointment_scheduled: 'customer_action',
  subscription_created: 'plan_enrollment',
  trial_started: 'plan_enrollment',
  custom: 'custom'
};

const TYPES_WITH_CONTENTS = 'contents,plan_enrollment,custom';
const TYPES_WITH_PLAN_ID = 'plan_enrollment,custom';
const STORE_USER_FIELDS = ['email_sha256', 'external_id_sha256', 'country', 'city', 'zip_code'];
const KNOWN_DATA_FIELDS = [
  'amount', 'amount_major', 'value', 'currency', 'contents', 'items', 'plan_id'
];

// These belong to the event itself, not to data. A row with one of these names
// sets the event id instead of going out inside data.
const EVENT_ID_FIELDS = ['event_id', 'eventId', 'id'];

const eventData = getAllEventData();
const storeCollection = data.storeCollection ? makeString(data.storeCollection).trim() : 'openai_ads';

let finished = false;

main();

function main() {
  if (isGtmPreviewPage()) {
    log('Message', 'The event came from the Tag Manager preview page, so nothing was sent.');
    return data.gtmOnSuccess();
  }

  if (data.adStorageConsent === 'required' && !isAdStorageGranted()) {
    log('Message', 'Ad storage consent is missing, so nothing was sent.');
    return data.gtmOnSuccess();
  }

  const event = buildEvent();
  const storeKey = data.useStore ? resolveStoreKey(event) : '';

  if (data.useStore && !storeKey) {
    log('Message', 'The Store document key resolved empty, so the Store was skipped.');
    return finishOnce(event);
  }

  if (data.useStore && data.storeRead && storeBaseUrl()) {
    return readFromStore(storeKey).then(function (response) {
      applyStoreResponse(event, response);
      finishOnce(event);
    }).catch(function (error) {
      log('Message', 'The Store read failed, so the event went out without enrichment.', error);
      finishOnce(event);
    });
  }

  return finishOnce(event);
}

function finishOnce(event) {
  if (finished) return;
  finished = true;

  const problem = validate(event);
  if (problem) {
    logToConsole({
      Name: TAG_NAME,
      Type: 'Message',
      Message: 'The event was blocked before the request. ' + problem
    });
    return data.gtmOnFailure();
  }

  writeIdentityCookies(event);

  if (data.useStore && data.storeWrite) {
    const storeKey = resolveStoreKey(event);
    if (storeKey) writeToStore(storeKey, event);
  }

  sendToOpenAi(event);
}

// Event building

function buildEvent() {
  const eventName = data.eventNameSource === 'custom' ? 'custom' : standardEventName();
  const obref = resolveObref();

  const event = {
    id: resolveEventId(),
    type: eventName,
    timestamp_ms: getTimestampMillis(),
    action_source: data.actionSource || 'web',
    opt_out: eventData.opt_out === true,
    user: buildUserData(obref),
    data: buildEventData(eventName)
  };

  if (eventName === 'custom' && data.eventNameCustom) {
    event.custom_event_name = makeString(data.eventNameCustom).trim();
  }

  const sourceUrl = eventData.page_location;
  if (sourceUrl) event.source_url = makeString(sourceUrl);

  const oppref = resolveOppref();
  if (oppref) event.oppref = oppref;

  return event;
}

// The Standard event field accepts a variable, so the name arrives untyped and it
// may not be one of the names OpenAI knows.
function standardEventName() {
  if (isBlank(data.eventNameStandard)) {
    log('Message', 'The standard event name resolved to nothing, so this event goes out as page_viewed. Check the variable in the Standard event field.');
    return 'page_viewed';
  }

  const name = makeString(data.eventNameStandard).trim();

  if (!DATA_TYPE_BY_EVENT[name]) {
    log('Message', 'OpenAI has no standard event called ' + name + ', so the event goes out with custom event data.');
  }

  return name;
}

function resolveEventId() {
  if (!isBlank(data.eventId)) return makeString(data.eventId).trim();

  const fromTable = eventIdFromTable();
  if (fromTable) return fromTable;

  const fromEvent = eventData.event_id || eventData.eventId;
  if (fromEvent) return makeString(fromEvent);

  log('Message', 'No event id was found, so this event carries a generated one and cannot be deduplicated with the pixel.');
  return uuidV4();
}

function eventIdFromTable() {
  const rows = data.eventDataTable || [];
  for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    const row = rows[i];
    if (!row || !row.name || isBlank(row.value)) continue;
    if (EVENT_ID_FIELDS.indexOf(row.name) !== -1) return makeString(row.value).trim();
  }
  return undefined;
}

function resolveOppref() {
  const pageLocation = eventData.page_location;
  if (pageLocation) {
    const parsed = parseUrl(makeString(pageLocation));
    if (parsed && parsed.searchParams && parsed.searchParams.oppref) {
      return makeString(parsed.searchParams.oppref);
    }
  }

  const cookie = firstCookie('__oppref');
  if (cookie) return cookie;

  if (eventData.oppref) return makeString(eventData.oppref);
  if (eventData.__oppref) return makeString(eventData.__oppref);

  return undefined;
}

function resolveObref() {
  const cookie = firstCookie('__obref');
  if (cookie) return cookie;

  if (eventData.obref) return makeString(eventData.obref);
  if (eventData.__obref) return makeString(eventData.__obref);
  if (data.setObrefCookie) return uuidV4();

  return undefined;
}

// Repair a value whose UTF-8 bytes were read as Latin-1 upstream.
// The CDN header that carries the city arrives as "ItajubÃ¡" for "Itajubá":
// the two bytes of "á" (C3 A1) became the two characters "Ã" and "¡". Rebuild
// the bytes and decode them as UTF-8 again.
//   encodeUriComponent gives the UTF-8 form of every character:
//     U+0080..U+00BF -> %C2%xx  and the byte we want is xx
//     U+00C0..U+00FF -> %C3%yy  and the byte we want is yy + 0x40, which in
//                               hex only moves the first digit: 8->C, 9->D,
//                               A->E, B->F
// The sentinel keeps a rewritten pair from being matched by the next rule.
// It is "#" because encodeUriComponent always escapes it, so it can never
// appear on its own inside the string being rewritten.
function repairMojibake(value) {
  const text = makeString(value);

  // A healthy string never carries these two characters, and this check is
  // what keeps it from being touched at all.
  if (text.indexOf('Ã') === -1 && text.indexOf('Â') === -1) return text;

  const bytes = encodeUriComponent(text)
    .split('%C2%').join('#')
    .split('%C3%8').join('#C')
    .split('%C3%9').join('#D')
    .split('%C3%A').join('#E')
    .split('%C3%B').join('#F')
    .split('#').join('%');

  const decoded = decodeUriComponent(bytes);

  // A string that merely contains "Ã" without being mojibake, an uppercase
  // "SÃO" say, rebuilds into bytes that are not valid UTF-8 and decodes to
  // nothing. There the original value is the right answer.
  if (decoded === undefined || decoded === null) return text;

  return decoded;
}

function buildUserData(obref) {
  const user = {};

  if (data.autoMapUserData) {
    const email = firstOf(
      getEventData('user_data.email') ||
      getEventData('user_data.email_address') ||
      getEventData('user_data.sha256_email_address') ||
      eventData.email
    );
    if (email) user.email_sha256 = hashEmail(email);

    if (eventData.user_id) user.external_id_sha256 = hashExternalId(eventData.user_id);

    const address = readAddress();
    if (address.city) user.city = truncate(lower(repairMojibake(address.city)), CITY_MAX);
    if (address.postal_code) user.zip_code = truncate(makeString(address.postal_code).trim(), ZIP_MAX);
    if (address.country) user.country = makeString(address.country).trim().toUpperCase();

    if (eventData.ip_override) user.ip_address = makeString(eventData.ip_override).trim();
    if (eventData.user_agent) user.user_agent = makeString(eventData.user_agent);
  }

  if (obref) user.obref = obref;

  const rows = data.userDataTable || [];
  for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    const row = rows[i];
    if (!row || !row.name || isBlank(row.value)) continue;
    setUserField(user, row.name, row.value);
  }

  return user;
}

function setUserField(user, name, value) {
  if (name === 'email_sha256') user.email_sha256 = hashEmail(value);
  else if (name === 'external_id_sha256') user.external_id_sha256 = hashExternalId(value);
  else if (name === 'country') user.country = makeString(value).trim().toUpperCase();
  else if (name === 'city') user.city = truncate(lower(repairMojibake(value)), CITY_MAX);
  else if (name === 'zip_code') user.zip_code = truncate(makeString(value).trim(), ZIP_MAX);
  else if (name === 'obref') user.obref = makeString(value).trim();
  else if (name === 'ip_address') user.ip_address = makeString(value).trim();
  else if (name === 'user_agent') user.user_agent = makeString(value);
}

function readAddress() {
  const userData = eventData.user_data;
  if (!userData) return {};

  let address = userData.address;
  if (getType(address) === 'array') address = address.length ? address[0] : undefined;

  return address || {};
}

function buildEventData(eventName) {
  const dataType = DATA_TYPE_BY_EVENT[eventName] || 'custom';
  const payload = {type: dataType};

  let currency;
  let amount;
  let contents;

  if (data.autoMapEventData) {
    let items = eventData.items;
    if (!items) items = getEventData('ecommerce.items');
    if (getType(items) !== 'array') items = undefined;

    currency = eventData.currency ? makeString(eventData.currency).trim().toUpperCase() : undefined;
    if (!currency && items) {
      for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
        if (items[i] && items[i].currency) {
          currency = makeString(items[i].currency).trim().toUpperCase();
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    if (items && items.length) contents = buildContents(items, currency);

    if (!isBlank(eventData.value)) {
      amount = toMinorUnit(eventData.value, currency);
    } else if (contents && contents.length) {
      amount = sumContents(contents);
    }
  }

  if (currency) payload.currency = currency;
  if (amount !== undefined) payload.amount = amount;
  if (contents && contents.length && TYPES_WITH_CONTENTS.indexOf(dataType) !== -1) payload.contents = contents;

  applyEventDataTable(payload, dataType);

  return payload;
}

function buildContents(items, currency) {
  const contents = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    const item = items[i];
    if (!item) continue;

    const content = {};
    if (item.item_id) content.id = makeString(item.item_id);
    if (item.item_name) content.name = makeString(item.item_name);
    if (!isBlank(item.quantity)) content.quantity = makeInteger(item.quantity);

    const itemCurrency = item.currency ? makeString(item.currency).trim().toUpperCase() : currency;
    if (item.currency) content.currency = itemCurrency;

    if (!isBlank(item.price)) {
      const itemAmount = toMinorUnit(item.price, itemCurrency);
      if (itemAmount !== undefined) content.amount = itemAmount;
    }

    content.content_type = item.content_type ? makeString(item.content_type) : 'product';
    contents.push(content);
  }

  return contents;
}

function sumContents(contents) {
  let total = 0;
  let found = false;

  for (let i = 0; i < contents.length; i++) {
    const content = contents[i];
    if (content.amount === undefined) continue;
    const quantity = content.quantity === undefined ? 1 : content.quantity;
    total = total + content.amount * quantity;
    found = true;
  }

  return found ? Math.round(total) : undefined;
}

function applyEventDataTable(payload, dataType) {
  const rows = data.eventDataTable || [];
  const values = {};

  for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    const row = rows[i];
    if (!row || !row.name || isBlank(row.value)) continue;
    values[row.name] = row.value;
  }

  if (values.currency) payload.currency = makeString(values.currency).trim().toUpperCase();

  if (values.plan_id) {
    if (TYPES_WITH_PLAN_ID.indexOf(dataType) !== -1) payload.plan_id = makeString(values.plan_id);
    else log('Message', 'plan_id was dropped because the event data type is ' + dataType + '.');
  }

  const rawContents = values.contents || values.items;
  if (rawContents) {
    const parsed = parseContents(rawContents);
    if (parsed && TYPES_WITH_CONTENTS.indexOf(dataType) !== -1) payload.contents = parsed;
    else if (parsed) log('Message', 'contents was dropped because the event data type is ' + dataType + '.');
  }

  const rawMajor = values.amount_major || values.value;
  if (rawMajor) {
    const converted = toMinorUnit(rawMajor, payload.currency);
    if (converted !== undefined) payload.amount = converted;
  }

  if (values.amount) {
    const explicit = makeInteger(values.amount);
    if (explicit === explicit) payload.amount = explicit;
  }

  for (let k = 0; k < rows.length; k++) {
    const name = rows[k] && rows[k].name;
    if (!name || isBlank(rows[k].value)) continue;
    if (KNOWN_DATA_FIELDS.indexOf(name) !== -1) continue;
    if (EVENT_ID_FIELDS.indexOf(name) !== -1) continue;
    payload[name] = rows[k].value;
  }
}

function parseContents(value) {
  if (getType(value) === 'array') return value;

  if (getType(value) === 'string') {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(value);
    if (getType(parsed) === 'array') return parsed;
  }

  return undefined;
}

// Validation

function validate(event) {
  if (!data.pixelId) return 'The OpenAI Pixel ID is empty.';
  if (!data.apiKey) return 'The API key is empty.';
  if (!event.id) return 'The event id is empty.';
  if (!event.timestamp_ms) return 'The event timestamp is empty.';
  if (!event.action_source) return 'The action source is empty.';
  if (event.action_source === 'web' && !event.source_url) {
    return 'The action source is web, so source_url is required. Send page_location on the incoming event.';
  }
  if (event.type === 'custom' && !event.custom_event_name) {
    return 'The event type is custom, so custom_event_name is required.';
  }

  const payload = event.data || {};
  if (payload.amount !== undefined && !payload.currency) {
    return 'The event carries an amount with no currency.';
  }

  if (getType(payload.contents) === 'array') {
    for (let i = 0; i < payload.contents.length; i++) {
      const content = payload.contents[i];
      if (!content) continue;
      if (content.amount !== undefined && !content.currency && !payload.currency) {
        return 'A content item carries an amount with no currency.';
      }
      if (content.content_type !== undefined && getType(content.content_type) !== 'string') {
        return 'A content item carries a content_type that is not a string.';
      }
    }
  }

  return undefined;
}

// OpenAI request

function sendToOpenAi(event) {
  const url = API_ENDPOINT + '?pid=' + encodeUriComponent(makeString(data.pixelId));

  const body = {
    integration_source: INTEGRATION_SOURCE,
    events: [event]
  };
  if (data.validateOnly) body.validate_only = true;

  const options = {
    method: 'POST',
    timeout: REQUEST_TIMEOUT,
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      Authorization: 'Bearer ' + makeString(data.apiKey)
    }
  };

  if (data.debug) {
    logToConsole({
      Name: TAG_NAME,
      Type: 'Request',
      Preview: isPreviewRequest(),
      EventName: event.type,
      RequestMethod: 'POST',
      RequestUrl: url,
      RequestBody: body
    });
  }

  const request = sendHttpRequest(url, options, JSON.stringify(body));

  if (data.optimistic) {
    data.gtmOnSuccess();
    request.then(function (response) {
      logResponse(response);
    }).catch(function (error) {
      log('Message', 'The OpenAI request failed after the tag reported success.', error);
    });
    return;
  }

  request.then(function (response) {
    logResponse(response);
    if (response && response.statusCode >= 200 && response.statusCode < 300) data.gtmOnSuccess();
    else data.gtmOnFailure();
  }).catch(function (error) {
    log('Message', 'The OpenAI request failed.', error);
    data.gtmOnFailure();
  });
}

function logResponse(response) {
  if (!data.debug || !response) return;
  logToConsole({
    Name: TAG_NAME,
    Type: 'Response',
    ResponseStatusCode: response.statusCode,
    ResponseBody: response.body
  });
}

// Wascer Store

function storeBaseUrl() {
  const header = getRequestHeader('x-url-api');
  if (!header) return undefined;

  let base = makeString(header).trim();
  while (base.length && base.substring(base.length - 1, base.length) === '/') {
    base = base.substring(0, base.length - 1);
  }

  const suffix = '/database';
  if (base.length > suffix.length && base.substring(base.length - suffix.length, base.length) === suffix) {
    base = base.substring(0, base.length - suffix.length);
  }

  return base;
}

function storeHeaders() {
  return {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'x-container-identifier': makeString(getRequestHeader('x-container-identifier') || ''),
    'x-user-id': makeString(getRequestHeader('x-user-id') || '')
  };
}

function resolveStoreKey(event) {
  const source = data.storeKeySource || 'obref';

  if (source === 'custom') {
    return data.storeKeyCustom ? makeString(data.storeKeyCustom).trim() : '';
  }

  const user = event.user || {};
  if (source === 'external_id') return user.external_id_sha256 || '';

  return user.obref || '';
}

function readFromStore(key) {
  const url = storeBaseUrl() +
    '/database/get?document_key=' + encodeUriComponent(key) +
    '&collection=' + encodeUriComponent(storeCollection);

  if (data.debug) {
    logToConsole({Name: TAG_NAME, Type: 'Request', RequestMethod: 'GET', RequestUrl: url});
  }

  return sendHttpRequest(url, {
    method: 'GET',
    timeout: STORE_TIMEOUT,
    headers: storeHeaders()
  });
}

function applyStoreResponse(event, response) {
  if (!response || response.statusCode !== 200 || !response.body) {
    log('Message', 'The Store had nothing to add for this event.');
    return;
  }

  const parsed = JSON.parse(response.body);
  const stored = parsed ? parsed.data : undefined;
  if (!stored) return;

  if (!event.oppref && stored.oppref) event.oppref = makeString(stored.oppref);

  if (!event.user) event.user = {};
  for (let i = 0; i < STORE_USER_FIELDS.length; i++) {
    const field = STORE_USER_FIELDS[i];
    if (!event.user[field] && stored[field]) event.user[field] = makeString(stored[field]);
  }
}

function writeToStore(key, event) {
  const base = storeBaseUrl();
  if (!base) return;

  const payload = {};
  if (event.oppref) payload.oppref = event.oppref;

  const user = event.user || {};
  for (let i = 0; i < STORE_USER_FIELDS.length; i++) {
    const field = STORE_USER_FIELDS[i];
    if (user[field]) payload[field] = user[field];
  }

  if (!Object.keys(payload).length) return;

  const url = base + '/database/collections/' + encodeUriComponent(storeCollection);
  const body = JSON.stringify({document_key: key, data: payload});

  if (data.debug) {
    logToConsole({
      Name: TAG_NAME,
      Type: 'Request',
      RequestMethod: 'POST',
      RequestUrl: url,
      RequestBody: payload
    });
  }

  sendHttpRequest(url, {
    method: 'POST',
    timeout: STORE_TIMEOUT,
    headers: storeHeaders()
  }, body).then(function (response) {
    if (response && response.statusCode === 201) return;
    log('Message', 'The Store write did not succeed.', response ? response.statusCode : undefined);
  }).catch(function (error) {
    log('Message', 'The Store write failed.', error);
  });
}

// Cookies

function writeIdentityCookies(event) {
  if (data.setOpprefCookie && event.oppref) {
    writeCookie('__oppref', event.oppref, data.opprefExpiration, 30);
  }

  const obref = event.user ? event.user.obref : undefined;
  if (data.setObrefCookie && obref) {
    writeCookie('__obref', obref, data.obrefExpiration, 365);
  }
}

function writeCookie(name, value, days, fallbackDays) {
  let lifetime = makeInteger(days);
  if (lifetime !== lifetime || lifetime <= 0) lifetime = fallbackDays;

  setCookie(name, value, {
    domain: cookieDomain(),
    path: '/',
    secure: true,
    sameSite: data.cookieSameSite || 'Lax',
    'max-age': lifetime * 86400
  }, false);
}

function cookieDomain() {
  const configured = data.cookieDomain ? makeString(data.cookieDomain).trim() : 'auto';
  if (configured && configured !== 'auto') return configured;

  const pageLocation = eventData.page_location;
  if (pageLocation) {
    const domain = computeEffectiveTldPlusOne(makeString(pageLocation));
    if (domain) return domain;
  }

  return 'auto';
}

// Consent and preview

function isAdStorageGranted() {
  const consentState = eventData.consent_state;
  if (consentState && getType(consentState.ad_storage) !== 'undefined') {
    return consentState.ad_storage === true || consentState.ad_storage === 'granted';
  }

  const gcs = eventData['x-ga-gcs'];
  if (gcs) {
    const signals = makeString(gcs);
    return signals.length > 2 && signals.substring(2, 3) === '1';
  }

  return false;
}

function isGtmPreviewPage() {
  const url = eventData.page_location || getRequestHeader('referer');
  if (!url) return false;
  return makeString(url).indexOf(GTM_PREVIEW_ORIGIN) === 0;
}

function isPreviewRequest() {
  return !!getRequestHeader('x-gtm-server-preview');
}

// Helpers

function toMinorUnit(value, currency) {
  const amount = makeNumber(value);
  if (amount !== amount) return undefined;

  const code = currency ? makeString(currency).trim().toUpperCase() : '';
  let multiplier = 100;
  if (code && ZERO_DECIMAL.indexOf(code) !== -1) multiplier = 1;
  else if (code && THREE_DECIMAL.indexOf(code) !== -1) multiplier = 1000;

  return Math.round(amount * multiplier);
}

function hashEmail(value) {
  const raw = makeString(value).trim();
  if (isHashed(raw)) return raw.toLowerCase();
  return sha256Sync(raw.toLowerCase(), {outputEncoding: 'hex'});
}

function hashExternalId(value) {
  const raw = makeString(value).trim();
  if (isHashed(raw)) return raw.toLowerCase();
  return sha256Sync(raw, {outputEncoding: 'hex'});
}

function isHashed(value) {
  const raw = makeString(value);
  if (raw.length !== 64) return false;

  for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
    if (HEX_ANY.indexOf(raw.substring(i, i + 1)) === -1) return false;
  }

  return true;
}

function uuidV4() {
  let time = getTimestampMillis();
  let out = '';

  for (let i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
    let nibble;
    if (i === 12) {
      nibble = 4;
    } else if (i === 16) {
      nibble = 8 + generateRandom(0, 3);
    } else if (i < 8) {
      nibble = (time + generateRandom(0, 15)) % 16;
      time = Math.floor(time / 16);
    } else {
      nibble = generateRandom(0, 15);
    }

    out = out + HEX_LOWER.substring(nibble, nibble + 1);
    if (i === 7 || i === 11 || i === 15 || i === 19) out = out + '-';
  }

  return out;
}

function firstCookie(name) {
  const values = getCookieValues(name);
  if (getType(values) === 'array' && values.length && values[0]) return makeString(values[0]);
  return undefined;
}

function firstOf(value) {
  if (getType(value) === 'array') return value.length ? value[0] : undefined;
  return value;
}

function isBlank(value) {
  return value === undefined || value === null || value === '';
}

function lower(value) {
  return makeString(value).trim().toLowerCase();
}

function truncate(value, max) {
  return value.length > max ? value.substring(0, max) : value;
}

function log(type, message, detail) {
  if (!data.debug) return;
  logToConsole({Name: TAG_NAME, Type: type, Message: message, Detail: detail});
}
